items.title: Bill Berry and Buster Cooper interviewed by Michael Woods, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: There are still records of Ellington’s that are coming out that I’m on that have never been released yet.

ctx.x: Could I just say one thing about Duke? Anytime we was off, if we were off for a month, we’d record for a month. That’s the way it seems.

Yes. It seemed like every time we had a day off or something we were making another record. I mean always. There are still records of Ellington’s that are coming out that I’m on that have never been released yet.
